model.label: Model
model.needFiles: To show the realistic twin, first pick your files in the “Realistic twin” tab.
model.twinActive: Showing the realistic twin: poses, camera and wardrobe use the same skeleton.

panel.title: Realistic twin
panel.description: Show your rigged 3D scan, generated locally from your own photos, instead of the standard mannequin. Poses, zoom and the wardrobe work as usual.
panel.privacy: Privacy: the files are kept only in this browser (IndexedDB); they are never uploaded and never part of the app. You can remove them at any time.
panel.pickHint: Choose one twin.glb bundle. Legacy rigged.glb + twin.json (+ mh2twin.bin) files also work.

status.partial: For a legacy scan, also choose twin.json. A twin.glb bundle needs no other files.
status.error: The twin could not be loaded.

panel.noMapping: No mapping file: the wardrobe only hides the scan right under the fabric; with thick clothes the scan may show through.
panel.alignment: Skeleton fit: at most {{residual}} mm apart
panel.howTo: To produce the files: python tools/twin-lab/rig/rig_scan.py <scan.glb> <output folder>

measures.title: Your twin's measurements
measures.note: These measurements come from the scan and are read-only. The estimated allowance for the clothes, hair and shoes in the scan is subtracted; the sliders only work in the standard model.

notes.face: The face photo belongs to the standard mannequin. The realistic twin has its own face and hair; your face is applied again when you return to the standard model.
notes.appearance: Skin tone, hair, eyebrow and eye settings belong to the standard mannequin. The realistic twin uses its own texture.

errors.json: twin.json is not a valid JSON file.
errors.version: This twin.json version is not supported.
errors.bones: The skeleton bones do not match the avatar's skeleton.
errors.macros: The macro values in twin.json are invalid.
errors.modifiers: The body adjustments in twin.json are invalid.
errors.measurements: The measurements in twin.json are invalid.
errors.mapping: The mapping file (mh2twin.bin) does not match the scan.
errors.glb: rigged.glb could not be read; pick a rigged GLB file.
errors.noSkin: The scan has no skeleton binding (skin).
errors.rest: The scan is not in the rest pose; use the output of rig_scan.py.
errors.mismatch: twin.json and rigged.glb do not seem to belong to the same scan.
errors.shape: The body shape could not be applied to the avatar.
errors.files: These files could not be read.
